race.description: 2026 Ladbrokes Sunshine Stars Yearling Sale Classic Heat 1 - 2yo Colts & Geldings
race.comment: PASSION AND PAIN (3) is in good form at present. Finished third at his latest appearance over 1609m at Newcastle, beaten 2.5 metres. Has the benefit of a good draw. This is a nice drop in grade so he is in the right race to find the winners' list. EXIT ELEVEN (7) scored at this track two starts back to make it two on the trot then was highly competitive again at his latest appearance over 1660m at at the same circuit, beaten 1.5 metres into second after being handy in the run. Has to contend with a very wide draw. Needs to be at his best to beat this field but he is good enough to play a major role. LOTS OF HEART (5) is heading the right way, improving last time out to finish second at this track over 1660m. Genuine threat. WAIT WHAT (6) is the best of the rest after finishing runner-up over 1780m at Redcliffe last time out.
